mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand in the economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals increased consumer spending, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
